name: Jiangsu Leili Motor Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Leili Motor Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of household appliances, micro motors, and intelligent components in China and internationally. It offers air conditioning motors and components comprising air guide motors and mechanism components, and brushless motors; washing machine motors and components consisting of drain motors and pumps, and dispensing system components; refrigerator motors and components, such as chiller motors and pad, crusher motor, and maker systems; and small appliance motors and components, including stepper motors, and brushless DC motors and components.
